dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper dorsal flank exhibit high-intensity white perimeters with soft, feathered gradients transitioning to dark-intensity interiors. Perimeter thickness is non-uniform, showing a stippled pixel distribution.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid white pixel clusters (blobs) is observed along the lower lateral and posterior regions. These clusters lack internal intensity gradients and are most concentrated towards the caudal end.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest 'O' rings in the upper-mid dorsal section form a scalene triangle. A distinct linear sequence of smaller high-intensity blobs follows the ventral-lateral contour of the body.
